description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the step the skill owns in the AI-video pipeline: a locked still plus blueprint turned into a provider-tuned motion prompt, including a provider switch and the native-audio sync it names. Near-misses use the skill's own named exclusions: a prose-only scene that must first go through scene-expander, and a still graphic (canvas-design), plus the end-to-end pipeline orchestration that sits above this step (video-director). Counterexamples guard 'motion' as UI animation and 'choreography' in its literal sense.

queries.q: the still for scene 4 is locked — write the Veo motion prompt from the blueprint
retune scene 2's motion prompt for Kling, we're switching off Sora
give me camera move, primary and secondary motion and physics for the locked hero shot
sync the native audio cue to the door slam in the motion prompt for scene 7
Bild ist ausgewählt, jetzt bitte den Motion-Prompt für Veo mit Kamerafahrt und Ton
turn this scene description into a structured blueprint
queries.note: the blueprint is still prose, which this skill's Do-NOT list sends first → scene-expander

queries.q: design a poster still for the film's title card
queries.note: a still graphic, named in this skill's Do-NOT list → canvas-design

queries.q: plan the whole video from script to final stitch
queries.note: end-to-end pipeline direction above the single motion-prompt step → video-director

queries.q: add a fade-in animation to the modal on open
queries.note: the 'motion' homonym — UI animation, not video-model prompting

queries.q: choreograph a dance routine for our team offsite
queries.note: the literal 'choreography' homonym with no video pipeline
